dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

6 اسکیل آماده برای جمنای 👇
تو Settings > Skills > Add skill اسم رو بنویس و متن رو تو Instructions بذار، بعد تو چت با / صداش کن:

1. study-coach
"Explain the material I share simply, then quiz me with 5 questions one at a time and correct my mistakes."
2. email-polish
"Rewrite my text as a short, polite English email with a subject line. Keep my meaning."
3. ielts-writing
"Estimate a band for each criterion of my IELTS Task 2 essay and list the 5 most important fixes."
4. cv-check
"Review my CV for the job I name: list missing keywords and rewrite 3 bullets with measurable results."
5. fact-check
"Separate facts from opinions in what I paste and tell me what to search to verify each fact."
6. decision-helper
"List my options with pros, cons and risks, then ask me one key question before I choose."

منبع: blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/gemini/automate-tasks-with-skills/
